result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: one audit per 12 months, 30 days' written notice, during business hours, by an independent auditor subject to written confidentiality obligations, with no direct or remote systems access; §22.2 retains the required cost allocation and 5% threshold. It preserves the core usage-verification and underpayment-recovery purpose. However, it goes modestly beyond the stated playbook by requiring all audits to be off-site, adding a minimal-disruption standard, and narrowing the audit expressly to usage. The direct-access prohibition is also duplicative of §22.2. Drafting is otherwise clear and professional.
